overview.title: System overview
overview.intro: Service health at a glance. Operations screens (transactions, KYC, risk, reconciliation) arrive in Phase 8.

status.errorDescription: Check that the backend is running, then try again.

auth.noPermission: You do not have permission to view this page.

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.description: Staff only. Two-factor authentication is required.

setup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.description: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password...), then enter the 6-digit code.
setup.qrAlt: QR code that adds VieWallet to your authenticator app

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator device.
recovery.warning: Store these codes somewhere safe. They are shown only once.

verify.title: Two-factor authentication
verify.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.description: This action is sensitive. Enter a fresh code from your authenticator app.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every important action is recorded and cannot be changed or deleted. The hash chain reveals tampered records.
